t2.title: Competitive sports beneficial or harmful for young children
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is competitive sports beneficial or harmful for young children?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Professional Pet Grooming: Necessity or Luxury?

This is a fascinating debate among pet owners. Having owned dogs for years, I believe professional grooming is more than just pampering.

Firstly, regular grooming prevents health issues. Professional groomers can spot early signs of skin conditions, parasites, or infections that owners might miss.

Moreover, certain breeds genuinely require professional care. Long-haired dogs need proper coat maintenance to prevent painful matting, while some breeds require specific grooming techniques.

Additionally, professional nail trimming and ear cleaning are difficult to perform safely at home without proper training and equipment.

However, I acknowledge that basic grooming can be done at home for short-haired breeds with minimal needs.

Ultimately, while not every pet needs monthly salon visits, professional grooming should be viewed as preventive healthcare rather than a luxury.

What's your experience with pet grooming?
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!

I have dog. Grooming is good. Dog is happy. I like it. Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,

I took my dog to the grooming place. It was good. The people were nice and my dog liked it. But it was expensive. I think they should have more toys for the dogs. And maybe cheaper prices. Thank you!
t2.sampleB1:
Dear Paws & Claws Team,

Thank you for your email. I wanted to give you some feedback about my recent visit. Overall, I was quite happy with the service. The groomer was very friendly and seemed to really care about my dog. The quality of the grooming was good, and my dog looked very smart afterwards.

However, I think you could improve a couple of things. Firstly, the waiting area was a bit small, especially when there were several dogs waiting. Also, it would be great if you offered a teeth cleaning service. I think many pet owners would be interested in that.

Thank you again for a good experience.

Sincerely,
A Happy Customer
t2.sampleB2:
Little Athletes: A Winning Start or Too Much Pressure?

Walk past any playground on a Saturday morning and you'll spot children chasing a ball, desperate to score. But is all this competition really good for young children? On the plus side, there's no denying the benefits. Team sports teach children how to cooperate, follow the rules and bounce back from defeat. A child who loses a match yet turns up again the following week is learning resilience that will serve them for life. Regular training also keeps them fit and active at a time when far too many youngsters are glued to screens. On the other hand, we shouldn't turn a blind eye to the drawbacks. When winning becomes everything, the pressure can be overwhelming. Some children burn out, or come to dread the very sport they once loved, especially when pushy parents or coaches take things too far. In my view, competitive sport is beneficial as long as it is handled sensibly. If the focus stays on enjoyment and effort rather than trophies, young children stand to gain far more than they lose. Ultimately, sport should build them up, not wear them down. Bekzod Aliyev
t2.uzSample:
Uy hayvonlarini professional parvarishlash: Zaruratmi yoki hashamat?

Bu uy hayvonlari egalari orasida qiziqarli bahs. Ko'p yillar davomida itlarga egalik qilib, men professional parvarishlash shunchaki erkalashdan ko'proq narsa deb hisoblayman.

Birinchidan, muntazam parvarishlash sog'liq muammolarining oldini oladi. Professional sartaroshlar egalari e'tibor bermasligi mumkin bo'lgan teri kasalliklari, parazitlar yoki infektsiyalarning erta belgilarini aniqlashlari mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, ayrim zotlar haqiqatan ham professional parvarishga muhtoj. Uzun sochli itlar og'riqli chigalliklarning oldini olish uchun to'g'ri jun parvarishiga muhtoj, ba'zi zotlar esa maxsus parvarishlash usullarini talab qiladi.

Qolaversa, professional tirnoq olish va quloqlarni tozalash to'g'ri tayyorgarlik va uskunalar bo'lmasa, uyda xavfsiz bajarish qiyin.

Biroq, men tan olamanki, minimal ehtiyojlarga ega bo'lgan qisqa sochli zotlar uchun asosiy parvarishlashni uyda ham bajarish mumkin.

Yakuniy xulosa shuki, har bir uy hayvoni har oyda salonga tashrif buyurishi shart bo'lmasa-da, professional parvarishlash hashamat emas, balki profilaktik sog'liqni saqlash sifatida qaralishi kerak.

Uy hayvonlarini parvarishlash bo'yicha sizning tajribangiz qanday?
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!

Menda it bor. Itni parvarish qilish yaxshi. It xursand. Menga yoqadi. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,

Men itimni sartaroshxonaga olib bordim. Yaxshi bo'ldi. Odamlar yaxshi edi va itimga yoqdi. Lekin qimmat edi. O'ylashimcha, itlar uchun ko'proq o'yinchoqlar bo'lishi kerak. Va balki arzonroq narxlar. Rahmat!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli Paws & Claws jamoasi,

Elektron pochtangiz uchun rahmat. Yaqinda tashrif buyurganim haqida ba'zi fikr-mulohazalarimni bermoqchi edim. Umuman olganda, xizmatdan juda mamnun bo'ldim. Sartarosh juda do'stona edi va itimga chin dildan g'amxo'rlik qilganga o'xshardi. Sartaroshlik sifati yaxshi edi va itim keyin juda aqlli ko'rindi.

Biroq, menimcha, siz bir-ikki narsani yaxshilashingiz mumkin. Birinchidan, kutish joyi biroz kichik edi, ayniqsa bir nechta itlar kutayotganida. Shuningdek, agar siz tish tozalash xizmatini taklif qilsangiz, juda yaxshi bo'lardi. O'ylaymanki, ko'plab uy hayvonlari egalari bundan manfaatdor bo'lishadi.

Yaxshi tajriba uchun yana bir bor rahmat.

Hurmat bilan,
Baxtli mijoz
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli "Paws & Claws" jamoasi,

Men sizning grooming saloningizda yaqinda bo'lgan tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, ko'rsatilgan xizmatlardan qoniqdim, lekin men ham potentsial yaxshilanishlar uchun ba'zi takliflarga egaman.

Groomingning sifati maqtashga arziydi. Mening itimning juni benuqson uslubda taralgan edi va groomer biroz xavotirli hayvon bilan muomala qilishda o'z mahoratini aniq ko'rsatdi. Xodimlaringiz tomonidan qo'llanilgan muloyim yondashuvni qadrladim, bu mening uy hayvonimni darhol xotirjam qildi.

Biroq, men umumiy mijozlar tajribasini yaxshilashingiz mumkin bo'lgan sohalar bor deb hisoblayman. Birinchidan, uchrashuvlarni rejalashtirish tizimi yanada soddalashtirilishi mumkin. Onlayn bron qilish jarayoni biroz murakkab tuyuldi. Ikkinchidan, premium xizmatlar uchun to'lov olish zarurligini tushunsam ham, narxlar tuzilishi biroz noaniq tuyuldi. Xarajatlarning batafsilroq taqsimoti foydali bo'ladi.

Qo'shimcha xizmatlar nuqtai nazaridan, uy hayvonlari egalari orasida keng tarqalgan muammo bo'lgan sezgir teri uchun maxsus muolajalarni joriy etishni ko'rib chiqishni taklif qilaman. Bundan tashqari, uyda groomingning asosiy usullari bo'yicha seminarlar taklif qilish yangi mijozlarni jalb qilishi va mijozlar sadoqatini mustahkamlashi mumkin.

Ushbu masalalarga e'tiboringiz uchun tashakkur. Kelajakda ushbu takliflarni qanday amalga oshirishingizni ko'rishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Qadrdon mijoz

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the grooming salon. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear Paws & Claws Team,

I am writing to express my satisfaction with your grooming services.

Firstly, your staff handled my dog with exceptional care. He is usually anxious around strangers, but your groomers made him feel at ease.

Moreover, the quality of grooming was outstanding. His coat looks incredibly healthy and well-maintained.

However, I have some suggestions. Offering appointment reminders via text message would be extremely helpful.

Additionally, providing a loyalty program with discounts for regular customers would be appreciated.

Furthermore, adding pet photography services after grooming could be a popular addition.

Thank you for caring for our beloved pets.

Warm regards,
A Happy Pet Owner
t12.sampleA1:
Hi Paws & Claws,
I like my dog clean. Good job. Dog happy. I happy. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Hi Paws & Claws,
Thank you for my dog. The dog is clean and smells good. I think the people are nice. But it is expensive. Maybe you can have cheaper price? And maybe you can wash cats too? I have a cat. Thank you!
t12.sampleB1:
Dear Paws & Claws Team,

Thank you for grooming my dog yesterday. I think the service was good. The staff were friendly and seemed to like animals. My dog looked very nice after the grooming.

However, I think you could improve a few things. For example, it would be good to have more information about the different types of shampoos you use. Also, maybe you could offer a discount for first-time customers. I would also like to see longer opening hours.

Overall, I was happy with the service and I would recommend your salon to other pet owners.

Sincerely,
A Pet Owner
t12.sampleB2: Dear Paws & Claws Team, I am writing to share some feedback following my recent visit with my dog, Max. On the whole, I was thoroughly impressed. To begin with, the quality of your grooming was excellent. Max's coat was beautifully trimmed and he came home looking healthier than ever. I was also grateful for how gentle your staff were; he tends to get nervous around strangers, but your groomers soon put him at ease. That said, there are a couple of things you might consider. Sending appointment reminders by text would be really helpful, as I nearly forgot my slot. I would also love to see a loyalty scheme for regular customers. Thank you for taking such good care of Max. I look forward to booking again. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova

Biroq, menimcha, rejalashtirish jarayonida yaxshilanishga joy bor. Bundan tashqari, mijozlarga parvarishlash seansi davomida ishlatiladigan aniq mahsulotlar haqida batafsil ma'lumot berish qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'ladi.

Ushbu masalalarga e'tiboringiz uchun tashakkur. Kelajakda uy hayvonim bilan qaytib kelishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Qoniqish hosil qilgan mijoz
